intake.line: The Laminated Org Chart: Prava, warm and practised, slides a laminated org chart across a laminate desk, explains tenure as the only currency and the onward as what it buys, and tells Milo his forty-one years of optimisation make him a strong culture fit for Reconciliations; for the first time in decades he feels seen, and he says yes before any choice is offered.

partition.line: Lanyard, Desk, Mentor: Milo is issued a lanyard and walked into the windowless, clockless Marrow District to a desk beside Zara Okafor, whose flat reply to his eager questions he decides to read as friendliness; his new life now has a quota, a neighbour, and a mentor who does not look up.

bell.line: Zero It Out: Zara teaches Milo the procedure in short commands, review the tenure, zero it, file the form that sends the soul under, and refuses to say where under is; Milo learns the work and learns that asking the next question earns only silence.

summons.line: Reply All: Milo drafts the all-staff email announcing the work stoppage, deletes every phrase of corporate jargon at Zara's instruction until only plain language is left, and sends it; the Marrow District stops hoping on schedule, and within minutes the summons to the corner office arrives.

corner office.line: The Office at the Top: Milo walks alone into the office no employee returns from unchanged and meets Edric Thane, who addresses him as Mr. Voss, reviews his numbers with real admiration, and offers him the climb the Lich himself once made; Milo recognises his own ambition in the offer and feels its full pull.

discrepancy.line: It Doesn't Reconcile: Closing a routine restructured account, Milo checks twice as he was taught and finds the tenure leaving the ledger faster than labour can explain, all of it flowing upward to one pooled account at the top of the org chart marked only CEL, which he has always assumed was a department; Zara, asked what it means, tells him to check it a third time.
